title: SwiftCart
summary: A Node/Express order portal with an in-memory store: an unsanitised download endpoint that path-traverses to a baked-in secrets file, an IDOR that exposes other customers' invoices and accounts (route param and query param), and a stored XSS in product reviews seeded with a raw <script> payload.

loot.description: a product review stored verbatim and rendered raw on the product page (stored XSS)
another customer's invoice, reachable unauthenticated by walking the id (IDOR)
a live payment-gateway API key in a baked-in secrets file the download endpoint traverses to
